newsitem.title: USA: Load of corp debt supply set to dock in U.S. mart.
newsitem.headline: Load of corp debt supply set to dock in U.S. mart.

text.p: The corporate bond primary market will sizzle with new offerings as a bulk load of supply gets set to dock on U.S. shores, players said.
"The tone is very good ... it's going to be a very busy week as players continue to line up to come to market," said one high-grade syndicate source.
So far about $2.1 billion in new investment-grade deals are slated to come to market, in addition to about $2.8 billion in new junk bonds this week, marfket sources said.
